item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directed military forces to undertake an operational deployment and specified the support mission; this is discretionary executive and Commander-in-Chief management, not a self-executing change in legal rights or a mandated later agency legal outcome.","evidence":"I directed a limited number of U.S. military forces to deploy to East Timor"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President authorized deployment of military assets and described their operational scope and anticipated duration. The consequence is executive military management, while the accompanying congressional report does not create a legal-rights consequence.","evidence":"I authorized the deployment of the amphibious ship, USS BELLEAU WOOD (LHA 3), and her embarked helicopters"}]}
